<@&1424461167883194418> Model updates: 2026-10-28

### 🆕 New
- 🧠 **GPT-6.1 Terra** (OpenAI): image input, tools and reasoning.
- 🧠 **Muse Spark 1.3** (Meta): image input, tools and reasoning.
- 🧠 **Mercury 3** (Inception): text reasoning and tools.
- 🧠 **Nemotron 3.5 Super VL** (NVIDIA): image input, tools and reasoning.
- 🧠 **Glyph Cluster (Stealth)** (Stealth): experimental coding model. Prompts and responses may be used for training.
- 🎨 **Qwen Image 2.1 Pro** (Qwen): generation and editing with up to 10 reference images.
- 🎬 **FLUX 3 Max** (Black Forest Labs): video with optional audio at 720p or 1080p.
- 🔊 **Sonilo 1.1 SFX** (Sonilo): sound effects timed to video.
- 🧊 **Tripo P2** (Tripo): text-to-3D GLB meshes.
- 🧠 **Decider V1.2 27B** (Perplexity): typed choices, scores and probabilities.
- 🧠 **D3** (vLLM Semantic Router): typed choices, scores and probabilities.

### 🗑️ Removed
- `perplexity/pplx-decider-v1.1-27b` (text). Its name is now an alias of Decider V1.2 27B.

### ⬇️ Price cuts
- 🧠 Text: Claude Opus 5.5 Fast (~5%) · GPT-4o Mini (~5%) · Kimi K2.7 Code (~15%) · Gemma 4 26B A4B (~15%) · Qwen3 Coder 30B (~50%).
- 🎨 Image: Nano Banana 2.1 (~10%) · Recraft V4.1 Flash (~5%) · Grok Imagine Image 2.0 (~5%) · Seedream 5.0 Pro (~60%).
- 🎬 Video: HeyGen Video 1 (~5% at 480p, ~35% at 768p) · Grok Imagine Video 1.5 (~5%) · Grok Video Pro (~30%) · Seedance 1.0 Pro Fast (~15% at 720p).
- 🔊 Audio (~20%): Text to Dialogue · Eleven Multilingual v2 · Eleven Flash v2.5 · Eleven v3.
- 🧊 3D: Asset Harvester (~70%).

### ⬆️ Price increases
- 🧠 Text: Mistral Large 4 output +100% · Step 5 Preview cached input +100% · Grok 4.20 cached input +525%.

### 🔒 Going paid-only
- GPT Image 2 · GPT Image 1.5 · GPT Image 1 Mini. Each also has a ~35% image output price increase.

### 🔓 Now free
- Microsoft-Decision-1.

Explore at https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs
